def transform(grid):
    import copy
    out = copy.deepcopy(grid)
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frames = []
    for color in range(1, 10):
        cells = [(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not cells:
            continue
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
        h=r1-r0+1; w=c1-c0+1
        if h < 3 or w < 3:
            continue
        if not (all(grid[r0][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                all(grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1))):
            continue
        mask=[[grid[r][c] == color for c in range(c0+1,c1)] for r in range(r0+1,r1)]
        frames.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,mask,any(map(any,mask))))
    sources=[f for f in frames if f[6]]
    if not sources:
        return out
    # The patterned frame is the template; match other frames by outer width.
    source=sources[0]
    _, sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1,mask,_=source
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1,tmask,has_pattern in frames:
        if color == source[0] or c1-c0 != sc1-sc0 or has_pattern:
            continue
        for dr,r in enumerate(range(r0+1,r1)):
            for dc,c in enumerate(range(c0+1,c1)):
                out[r][c]=color if dr < len(mask) and dc < len(mask[0]) and mask[dr][dc] else 0
    return out

def parse(s):
    return [[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in s.strip().splitlines()]

    out = copy.deepcopy(grid)
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frames = []
    for color in range(1, 10):
        cells = [(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not cells: continue
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2: continue
        if not (all(grid[r0][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1))): continue
        mask=[[grid[r][c] == color for c in range(c0+1,c1)] for r in range(r0+1,r1)]
        frames.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,mask,any(map(any,mask))))
    sources=[f for f in frames if f[6]]
    if not sources: return out
    scolor,sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1,mask,_=sources[0]
    source_width=sc1-sc0+1
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1,tmask,has_pattern in frames:

        if c1-c0+1 != source_width:
            for r in range(r0,r1+1):

            continue
        for dr,r in enumerate(range(r0+1,r1)):
            for dc,c in enumerate(range(c0+1,c1)):
                out[r][c]=color if dr < len(mask) and dc < len(mask[0]) and mask[dr][dc] else 0
